title: Horror Golf
description:
STORY:Minigolf game with darker theme and 2 different levels which all has 14 holes. So play totally 28 holes alone and try to get as good result as can. Levels has darker horror themes and several different obstacles like gravestones, skulls, skeletons and dark themed music. Take a swing at this amazing mini-golf game! Enjoy the realistic gameplay. Try to play every hole under par score. Player can also change ball skins and color

• 2 different darker themed levels. All has 14 holes so totally 28 holes
- Par system
- Restart hole
- Different obstacles with darker theme like skeletons, skulls, gravestone
- Different golfball skins
description_short: Minigolf game with darker horror themed maps. 2 different levels with totally 28 holes. Play alone and try to make good score
